purpose: Transcription record for gem selection. Read from rendered page images on 2026-10-02. This is a second, independent entry of the data in src/report/gemstoneTables.js; test-gemstones.js asserts the two agree.
format: Tilak Raj entries are 'VERDICT|houses the book says the planet rules|flags'. Flags: dasha = tied to the planet's major period; own / exalted = if in its own sign / exalted; at=1,2,4 = if the planet stands in those houses; with=Mars+Moon = worn together with those planets' gems; eye = if eye trouble; extreme = only in extreme need; duhsthana = book says 'lord of Duhsthana' without a number; slip = printed with the wrong gem's name.

planetGems.source: Kapoor printed p.76 (PDF 72): the Jataka Parijata verse; the English rendering omits Saturn, the verse gives nila (blue sapphire)

tamilNames.source: Jathaka Alangaram (Saraswati Mahal 2007) commentary, OCR text only, page not verified

kapoorRule: Never strengthen the lords of the 6th, 8th and 12th; their gems only in exceptional circumstances (printed p.78). The Ascendant lord's gem may be worn in the period of any planet (printed p.77).

tableNotes: Cancer's malefic column is blank in print
Libra's malefic column reads 'Do' (ditto), read as the row above (Virgo)
Sagittarius is split across two pages
rules: PDF 122: wear a planet's gem in its dasha/antardasha only (the Indian astrologers' view)
PDF 123: later practice - lords of 1, 5, 9 or exalted/yogakaraka planets from Ascendant or Moon sign (whichever is stronger); not 6, 7, 8, 12 lords or debilitated/combust planets
PDF 124 section 4.8: favourable are lords of 1, 4, 5, 9, 10; never the gem of a functional malefic

tilakRaj.page: printed pp.25-32 (PDF 29-36); pp.25-32 all viewed as images

knownBookErrors: Pisces, Venus: the book says lord of the 3rd and 7th; Venus rules the 3rd and 8th from Pisces (printed p.32).
Sagittarius, Topaz: the entry says 'Emerald is a Jeevana Ratna'; Jupiter's gem is the topaz/yellow sapphire (printed p.30).
tilakRajOmitsLordship: Sagittarius, Moon: calls it 'lord of Duhsthana' without a number
Aquarius, Saturn: the 12th (mentions it as not harming)
tilakRajMainPoints: printed p.33: a gem that does not suit the sign should not be worn; a friendly gem of the Ascendant lord may be; consider rise and combustion; gems of combust planets enhance their power; analyse major and sub periods, aspects, exaltation and debilitation; only on the finger concerned; a man's gem on the left-hand finger benefits his wife, a woman's on the right-hand finger benefits her husband; only the best piece.
